item.taoyuan.taoyuan_flower.lore: Long ago... this place was known as TaoYuan...
message.taoyuan.sky_terror: %s: Here... it's so high up... what am I supposed to do this high up... even the protagonist of a novel would never survive a place this high... I won't die from the fall, will I...?
message.taoyuan.seven_sword: %s: Here... it's so dark... I've been afraid of the dark since I was a child... unknown things appear in the dark... will the seven-sword I imagined show up in the dark? The seven-sword rewards the good with seven taels of silver, the supremely good with a whole gold ingot, the great evildoers are pierced through the dantian. But I have never once done a good deed in my life -- I will die, I will surely be pierced through the dantian by the seven-sword.
death.attack.taoyuan.sky_terror: %s was found splattered on the ground far below.
death.attack.taoyuan.seven_sword: %s was pierced through the dantian by the seven-sword.
message.taoyuan.judgment_echo: I heard the echo of the calamity.
message.taoyuan.judgment_summon: The calamity-bringer has summoned the seven-sword. The seven-sword will judge everyone.
message.taoyuan.scapegoat_echo: I heard the echo of the scapegoat.
message.taoyuan.scapegoat_puppet: A puppet imbued with a strand of scapegoat sorcery bore the seven-sword's judgment in your place
message.taoyuan.god_does_not_die: A god does not die in vain.
message.taoyuan.sword_cannot_judge_god: The seven-sword cannot judge a god
